$description: Apple (dark appearance, pointer tier) — standalone W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens.

sharedDos: Read all colors, radii, typography, and surface finishes through theme roles (`colors.*`, `shape.*`, `font.*`, `finish.*`) rather than literals in component code.
Read theme getters inside JSX render expressions or reactive effects so runtime theme switching (`selectTheme`) and light/dark appearance changes take effect on the next frame.
Use `rounded(shape.<role>, inset)` for concentric nested radii inside cards, switches, and segmented controls.
sharedDonts: Never write color literals (`#...`, `rgb()`, `oklch()`) in component, lib, or demo-adapter code.
Never store `colors.*`, `finish.*`, or `shape.*` values in module-level constants; they freeze on theme or appearance switches.
Never delete finish fields or alter the merged finish key set across appearances or themes.
designMd.voiceOmitted: Voice & Content Strategy is intentionally omitted: this theme defines visual tokens, surface finishes, typography metrics, and motion physics only; product copy, tone, capitalization, and terminology belong to the host application.
designMd.overview: Apple Human Interface Guidelines / UIKit system palette (`systemBlue`, `systemGroupedBackground`, `label`) with Retina 0.5px hairlines, capsule buttons, continuous corners, and Liquid Glass on floating and raised surfaces.
designMd.elevation: Apple Liquid Glass and Retina hairline depth: `glass`, `menu`, and `raised` finishes request `material.apple` (`glass: "regular"`) with iOS backdrop fallback (`ios.backdrop`) and 0.5px borders; other surfaces stay flat with subtle shadows.
dos: Use `999px` capsule corners on button-like controls (`shape.corners.button: "full"`) alongside `8px` controls/fields, `12px` containers, and `26px` modals with `shape.curve: "continuous"`.
Respect pointer (macOS: 13px body, 32px density row) vs touch (iOS: 17px body, 44px hit target) metrics.
Keep `material.apple` on `glass`, `menu`, and `raised` finishes and spread `platformMaterial()` on native views.
donts: Do not replace Retina `0.5px` `stroke.hairline`/`stroke.surface` with thick borders or `circular` corners.
Do not set `macos.backdrop` when Liquid Glass `glassEffect` is active on macOS 26+.

cubicBezier.$description: Named timing curves shared across themes.

out-cubic.$description: Exact cubic-bezier equivalent of NSH Easing.out(Easing.cubic).

in-cubic.$description: Exact cubic-bezier equivalent of NSH Easing.in(Easing.cubic).

decelerate.$description: WinUI 3 Fast Out, Slow In curve (entering elements).

accelerate.$description: WinUI 3 Slow Out, Fast In curve (exiting elements).

typography.$description: Semantic typography roles referencing tier-specific font.size and font.line-height.

caption.$description: Small captions and segmented counter labels.

detail.$description: Sidebar section labels, counts, and supporting metadata.

body.$description: Standard body copy, list rows, and dialog content.

label.$description: Control labels, form labels, and interactive triggers.

display.$description: Large display numerals and hero headings.

dimension.$description: Desktop pointer layout density, control geometry, and icon sizes.

shape.$description: Semantic corner radius roles by layer, referencing base dimension.radius.* tokens.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page elements: buttons, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for containers and overlays: cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for modal surfaces: dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

hairline.$description: Retina 0.5px hairline divider width per Apple HIG.

surface.$description: Retina 0.5px container surface hairline width per Apple HIG.

focus.$description: Focus ring geometry and style enum.

offset.$description: Focus ring outward offset from control bounds.

radius.$description: Apple HIG corner radius scale (8px control, 12px container, 26px modal; capsule buttons via shape.corners.button).

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

size.$description: Ergonomic sizing scales for pointer input.

hit.$description: Minimum hit target size (0 disables padding expansion).

density.$description: Page-level row, padding, gap, and surface spacing metrics.

control.$description: Control internal geometry and switch size tier.

shape.$description: Non-dimensional corner curve and button capsule flag.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities, press scale, and ripple switch.

overlay.$description: State-layer ink opacities for hover, focus, pressed, and dragged states.

accent-pressed-opacity.$description: Pressed opacity for accent controls when no pressed accent finish replaces it.

disabled.$description: UIKit disabled content opacity multiplier (0.3); containers keep resting fills.

motion.$description: Interactive spring and timing physics roles.

press.$description: Spring or timing physics for press-down feedback.

settle.$description: Spring or timing physics for release settling.

control.$description: Spring or timing physics for small control toggles and thumbs.

move.$description: Spring or timing physics for layout and indicator movement.

controls.$description: Named per-theme control geometry preset family (base | material | winui).

mono.$description: Monospace font family for code blocks and numeric readouts.

size.$description: Font sizes per type role for pointer input.

line-height.$description: Unitless line-height ratios per type role for pointer input.

color.$description: Adaptive A-layer and B-layer color roles for dark appearance.

brand-fill.$description: Primary brand action fill, aliased to {color.primary} (UIKit systemBlue).

on-brand.$description: Foreground text and icons on brand-fill surfaces, aliased to {color.primary-foreground}.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (40% black).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

chart-foreground.$description: Dark ink on light chart tiles matching UIKit light label (#000000).

window-close.$description: macOS window close traffic-light button fill.

window-minimize.$description: macOS window minimize traffic-light button fill.

window-zoom.$description: macOS window zoom traffic-light button fill.

card.$description: Elevated list and card surface (UIKit systemBackground).

popover.$description: Floating popover and sheet surface (UIKit secondarySystemBackground / popover).

hover.$description: Pointer hover tint (6% foreground ink over transparent).

brand-edge.$description: Hairline border on primary accent-filled controls.

popover-foreground.$description: Primary text and icon ink on popover surfaces.

accent-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on accent surfaces.

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on secondary control surfaces.

ring.$description: Focus ring color matching UIKit systemBlue.

sidebar-accent-foreground.$description: Text and icon ink on active sidebar rows.

on-accent-pressed.$description: Ink on pressed accent control fills.

card.$description: The card face: an inner highlight, a hairline, a contact shadow and a cast one.

section.$description: The flat surface a section's content or card sits on (no shadow by default).

inset.$description: The well inside a card: sunk by its inner shadow alone.

field.$description: A field well: its edge and its inner shadow.

raised.$description: Raised control surface with Liquid Glass material (regular) and hairline shadow.

hover.$description: The step the surface takes under the pointer.

pressed.$description: The step it takes while pressed.

light.$description: The main action brightest step: the accent gradient.

accent.$description: The accent face (the same as light).

accentPressed.$description: The accent control surface while pressed (identical to accent when dimmed via state.accent-pressed-opacity).

track.$description: A groove: an inner shadow and an edge.

fill.$description: The filled run: a slider, a progress bar, a switch that is on.

handle.$description: A slider handle (kept apart from knob).

pill.$description: The upstream capsule, left to the app.

thumb.$description: The chosen segment of a segmented control or a tag.

on.$description: A chosen switch or box, and the mark on it.

chip.$description: A chosen value label inside a field: a fill, an inner highlight and an edge.

glass.$description: Liquid Glass overlay surface with translucent popover fill, 30px blur fallback, and regular/thin Apple material.

menu.$description: Floating menu/popover surface with translucent popover fill, hairline + drop shadow, and Liquid Glass material.

dialog.$description: A dialog face: the card colour with the menu shadow.

grabber.$description: The drag handle pill at the top of a bottom sheet.

tooltip.$description: A tooltip face: the popover pane, without a shadow.

inverse.$description: Toast/inverse floating surface using Liquid Glass material over inverse fill.

groove.$description: A groove cut inside a menu.
